title: Uniform event probability as an indicator average
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty measurable space whose singletons are measurable, and let $E\subseteq\Omega$. The uniform probability measure of $E$ equals the uniform average over $\Omega$ of the indicator of membership in $E$.
